questions.stem: 人工智慧（AI）工具畫圖的速度比任何畫家都快得多，迫使許多國家檢討著作權法。
questions.answer: Artificial intelligence tools can draw pictures much faster than any painter can, forcing many countries to review their copyright laws.
accepted_answers: AI tools can draw pictures far more quickly than any human artist, forcing many countries to re-examine their copyright laws.
The speed at which AI tools draw pictures is much faster than that of any painter, compelling many countries to reconsider their copyright laws.

questions.stem: 然而，單純用人工智慧（AI）工具產生圖片或文章，在法律上通常不被視為創作行為。
questions.answer: However, merely using AI tools to generate pictures or articles is usually not regarded as a creative act under the law.
accepted_answers: However, simply using AI tools to produce pictures or articles is not usually considered a creative act in the eyes of the law.
However, generating images or texts simply with AI tools is generally not seen as an act of creation in legal terms.

1.explanation_zh: 「AI 工具畫圖的速度比任何畫家都快得多」最自然的英文是以工具當主詞：Artificial intelligence (AI) tools can draw pictures much faster than any painter (can)，加強比較級用 much／far，不用 very；如果堅持用「速度」當主詞，比較對象要對等：The speed at which AI tools draw pictures is much faster than that of any painter。「迫使許多國家檢討著作權法」是前面整件事造成的結果，中文接在逗號後沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 , forcing many countries to review their copyright laws（force + 受詞 + to VR）；也可以用 , which forces … 指前面整件事。
evidence: 迫使許多國家檢討著作權法
1.strategy_zh: 「A 做某事的速度比 B 快」改成 A + V + faster than B；看到「…，迫使／造成…」這種沒有主詞的結果句，先想句尾分詞 , forcing／causing …。
hints: 切成四段：人工智慧（AI）工具畫圖的速度／比任何畫家都快得多／迫使許多國家／檢討著作權法
標的詞彙：tool（工具）、draw（畫）、picture（圖畫）、fast（快的）、painter（畫家）、force（迫使）、country（國家）、review（檢討）、copyright（著作權）、law（法律）
句型框架：S + can V + much faster than any + N (can), forcing + O + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 主詞是動作「單純用 AI 工具產生圖片或文章」，英文用動名詞片語 Simply using AI tools to generate pictures or articles（use + 工具 + to VR），動名詞片語視為單數，動詞用 is。「在法律上通常不被視為」用被動 is usually not regarded as（considered、seen as 也可以），「在法律上」可寫 under the law／legally／in the eyes of the law，放句首或句尾都可以。「創作行為」譯成 a creative act 或 an act of creation，不要逐字寫成 creating behavior。
evidence: 單純用人工智慧（AI）工具產生圖片或文章
2.strategy_zh: 中文主詞是一個動作時，先想動名詞片語當主詞（動詞用單數）；看到「被視為」用 be regarded as／be considered。
hints: 切成四段：然而，單純用人工智慧（AI）工具產生圖片或文章／在法律上／通常不被視為／創作行為
標的詞彙：tool（工具）、generate（產生）、picture（圖片）、article（文章）、law（法律）、usually（通常）、regard（視為）、creative（創作的）
句型框架：However, (simply) V-ing … + is usually not regarded as + N + under the law.

The speed at which AI tools draw pictures is much faster than that of any painter, compelling many countries to reconsider their copyright laws.

traps.literal_error: AI tools' drawing speed is much faster than any painter, forcing many countries to review their copyright laws.
traps.explanation_zh: 照字面以「速度」當主詞，就要和畫家的「速度」比（than that of any painter）；最自然的寫法是改用工具當主詞：AI tools can draw pictures much faster than any painter (can)。

traps.literal_error: AI tools can draw pictures much faster than any painter, forced many countries to review their copyright laws.
traps.explanation_zh: 「迫使…」前面沒有主詞，英文不能直接再接一個過去式動詞；改用句尾分詞 forcing …（或 , which forces …）表示前面整件事造成的結果。

bonus.text: So fast can AI tools turn out pictures that no painter can keep up, which has driven many countries to rethink their copyright laws.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + adv. + can + S + V … that … 是倒裝的「如此…以致於…」；turn out（產出）、keep up（跟上）、drive sb to VR（驅使某人去做）是進階搭配。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「AI 工具畫圖的速度比任何畫家都快」照字面以「速度」當主詞，比較對象容易不對等；改以工具當主詞 AI tools can draw pictures much faster than any painter (can)。「迫使許多國家…」接在逗號後、沒有主詞，用句尾分詞 , forcing many countries to review … 表示結果。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：「人工智慧（AI）工具畫圖的速度」最自然的寫法是以工具當主詞：AI tools／Artificial intelligence tools + can draw (create／produce／paint) pictures (images)；若以「速度」當主詞（The speed at which AI tools draw pictures …），後面的比較對象也要是速度：is much faster than that of any painter（any painter's）；「比任何畫家都快得多」much／far／a lot + faster／more quickly + than any (human) painter／artist (can)；「迫使」forcing／compelling／pushing／driving／prompting 都給分，寫成 , which forces／has forced／is forcing many countries to …（which 指前面整件事）也算達成本句 PART（句尾結果）標的；「許多國家」many countries／nations；「檢討」review／re-examine（reexamine）／reconsider／rethink／revisit／re-evaluate／reassess；「著作權法」(their／the) copyright law(s)。主要子句後不可直接接 forced 或 it forces（兩個主要動詞沒有連接詞）。另外也給分：Today's AI tools、AI tools can create artwork；reexamine（不加連字號）、take another look at their copyright laws。

traps.zh: 單純用人工智慧（AI）工具產生圖片或文章
traps.literal_error: However, simply use AI tools to generate pictures or articles is usually not regarded as a creative act.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文以動作當主詞，英文不能用原形動詞 use 開頭當主詞，要改成動名詞 using（或 To use …），動詞用單數 is。

traps.literal_error: …is usually not regarded as a creating behavior under the law.
traps.explanation_zh: 「創作行為」是抽象名詞，英文說 a creative act／an act of creation；逐字翻成 creating behavior 不自然。

bonus.text: In the eyes of the law, merely prompting an AI tool to churn out pictures or articles hardly counts as an act of creation.
bonus.explanation_zh: prompt（對 AI 下指令）、churn out（大量產出）、hardly counts as（幾乎算不上）是進階用字；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文主詞是動作「單純用 AI 工具產生圖片或文章」，英文改成動名詞片語 Simply using AI tools to generate … 當主詞，動詞用單數 is；「不被視為」用被動 is not regarded as。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：「然而」However 放句首；「單純」simply／merely／just／only 都可以，也可以放在 with AI tools 前（generating … simply with AI tools）或寫 using AI tools alone；「產生」generate／produce／create／make；「圖片或文章」pictures／images 配 articles／texts；「在法律上」under the law、legally、in the eyes of the law、in legal terms、from a legal point of view、legally speaking，放在 However 之後或句尾都可以；「通常不被視為」is usually not／not usually／generally not + regarded as／considered (to be)／seen as／viewed as；「創作行為」a creative act、an act of creation、a creative activity、creative work 都給分。主詞要是動名詞片語（或 To use …），動詞用單數 is。另外也給分：However, legally (speaking), simply using AI tools to …（「在法律上」放在 However 之後）、However, generating pictures or articles simply (merely) by using AI tools / with AI tools alone …、is typically not counted as …、a creative process。

1.translation: Artificial intelligence (AI) tools can draw pictures much faster than any painter, forcing many countries to review their copyright laws.
1.explanation_zh: 「快得多」用 much faster than any painter；「迫使」用分詞構句 forcing … to V 接在主要子句後，避開時態選擇；「檢討」譯為 review。

2.translation: However, simply using AI tools to produce pictures or articles is usually not legally regarded as an act of creation.
2.explanation_zh: 「單純用 AI 工具產生…」整段當主詞，用動名詞片語 simply using … to produce；「被視為」用被動 be regarded as；「在法律上」用副詞 legally。

issues_zh: references[2]「The speed at which AI tools draw pictures is much faster than that of any painter」：speed 是名詞，習慣用 high／great 形容，「speed is (much) faster」是教學上常被糾正的搭配；本站範文會被學生模仿，建議改成 is much higher than that of any painter 或 far exceeds that of any painter，notes_zh 對應的說明（is much faster than that of any painter）也一併改。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者對參考譯文有意見（warn）：references[2]「The speed at which AI tools draw pictures is much faster than that of any painter」：speed 是名詞，習慣用 high／grea

1.translation: Artificial intelligence (AI) tools can draw pictures much faster than any painter, forcing many countries to review their copyright laws.
1.explanation_zh: 「速度比任何畫家都快得多」用 much faster than any painter（比較級加 much 強調，any 後接單數名詞）；「迫使……檢討」用分詞構句 forcing many countries to review，主詞 AI tools 與前半句的因果關係自然銜接；著作權法用複數 copyright laws。

2.translation: However, simply using AI tools to generate images or articles is usually not regarded as a creative act in the eyes of the law.
2.explanation_zh: 「單純用……產生」以動名詞片語 simply using ... 當主詞，動詞用單數 is；「被視為」用 be regarded as；「在法律上」譯為 in the eyes of the law（亦可用 legally），「創作行為」用 a creative act。
